definitions.explanation: A room used for administrative work, clerical duties, or official business in schools, organizations, or companies.

examples.japanese: {事務室|じむしつ}で{書類|しょるい}を{受|う}け{取|と}る。
examples.english: I receive documents at the office.

examples.japanese: {質問|しつもん}があれば{事務室|じむしつ}に{来|き}てください。
examples.english: If you have questions, please come to the office.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{事務室|じむしつ}で{証明書|しょうめいしょ}を{発行|はっこう}してもらった。
examples.english: I had a certificate issued at the school office.

notes:
{事務室|じむしつ} combines {事務|じむ} (office work) + {室|しつ} (room).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {事務室|じむしつ}: administrative office (specific room)
- {事務所|じむしょ}: office (building or workplace)
- オフィス: office (from English, general)
- {研究室|けんきゅうしつ}: research lab / professor's office

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {学校|がっこう}の{事務室|じむしつ} (school administrative office)
- {病院|びょういん}の{事務室|じむしつ} (hospital office)

RELATED ～{室|しつ} COMPOUNDS:
- {教室|きょうしつ} (classroom)
- {会議室|かいぎしつ} (meeting room)
- {待合室|まちあいしつ} (waiting room)
